title: 第一卷 第19章 跪下道歉第一卷 第20章 大地暴熊
content_zh:
“我辈武者，不能见死不救！”
聂远毅然决然，冲着前方冲去。
刚得到了一柄人级上品战剑，他现在信心十足。
“跟上吧！”
叶寒摇摇头，与赵一剑、何青峰二人追随而去。
穿越林间不过五百米，就看到丛林染血，战斗激烈。
十几具魔人尸体躺在地上，还有八尊魔人悍不畏死般围攻着一男一女，看那两人穿着，应是轮回书院外门弟子。
“师兄，救我！”
那女子惨叫一声，肩膀染血，差一点就被魔人撕掉了胳膊。
男弟子爆喝，一剑刺出，千钧一发之际将那女子救下。
可惜，就在这一刹那之间战况折转，毕竟被八尊魔人围攻，男子一时分心，被一尊魔人狠狠拳击在后背，一个趔趄扑倒在地，濒临身死。
“怎么办，欧阳师兄，我不想死，怎么办啊。”
女弟子六神无主，泪珠滚滚。
“救……救命！”
扑倒在地的男子满脸绝望。
“杀！”
聂远的声音突兀响起，直接冲向前方，在关键时刻一剑杀出。
那尊继续轰向男子的魔人，手臂咔嚓飞出。
“孽畜，死吧。”
聂远呼叫着，又是一剑横绝而出。

魔人鲜血溅出，被聂远一剑贯穿身躯，当场死绝。
相比那接近精疲力尽的魔人，聂远简直是来势汹汹，霸气威猛。
嗤！
剑体抽出，带动一串鲜血溅落。
“啊……你做什么？”
那女弟子尖叫，被溅到不少鲜血，瞪着聂远：“你没长眼睛吗？”
“嘿，不好意思。”
聂远讪讪一笑，急忙冲着又一尊魔人杀去。
叶寒等人也在出手，八尊魔人，不过片刻就已经被杀死当场。
这几尊魔人相比较来说还是很强的，只是战斗消耗严重，否则聂远独战其中之一都未必能赢。
八只魔人杀死，被救下的两人终于松一口气，只感觉自己从地狱的边缘走了一趟。
“不知师兄、师姐如何称呼？”
聂远露出笑容，擦拭着战剑上的鲜血：“我叫聂远，他们是……。”
“师兄，你看嘛，这个臭杂役弟子溅我一身血。”
聂远的声音被那女子嚷嚷声打断。
地上躺着的男子喘着粗气，略微摇头示意：“师妹，还有没有血魄丹？”
“有的，欧阳师兄！”
女子急忙拿出一个水晶瓶，倒出一枚圆滚滚的血红色丹药。
content_en:
"We, warriors, cannot ignore death without rescuing someone!"
Nie Yuan resolutely rushed forward.
He had just obtained a high-quality human-level war sword, and he was now full of confidence.
"Follow me!"
Ye Han shook his head and followed with Zhao Yijian and He Qingfeng.
After walking only five hundred meters through the forest, I saw the jungle was stained with blood and the fighting was fierce.
A dozen demon corpses were lying on the ground, and eight demons were surrounding a man and a woman without fear of death. Judging from the clothes of those two people, they should be outer disciples of Samsara Academy.
"Brother, save me!"
The woman screamed, her shoulder was covered in blood, and her arm was almost torn off by the demon.
The male disciple shouted loudly, thrust out his sword, and rescued the woman at the last moment.
Unfortunately, the situation of the battle turned around at this moment. After all, he was besieged by eight demons. The man was momentarily distracted and was punched hard in the back by one of the demons. He stumbled to the ground and was on the verge of death.
"What should I do, Senior Brother Ouyang, I don't want to die, what should I do?"
The female disciple was helpless, with tears rolling down her face.
"Help...help!"
The man who fell to the ground looked desperate.
"Kill!"
Nie Yuan's voice suddenly sounded, he rushed forward and struck out with his sword at the critical moment.
The arm of the demon who continued to attack the man flew out with a click.
"You evil beast, die."
Nie Yuan shouted, and another sword came out.
The devil's blood spattered out, and Nie Yuan's sword penetrated his body, killing him on the spot.
Compared to the demon who was nearly exhausted, Nie Yuan was simply menacing and domineering.
laugh!
The sword body was drawn out, causing a stream of blood to splash down.
"Ah...what are you doing?"
The female disciple screamed and was splashed with a lot of blood. She glared at Nie Yuan: "Don't you have eyes?"
"Hey, sorry."
Nie Yuan smiled and hurriedly killed another demon.
Ye Han and others also took action, and the eight demons were killed on the spot in just a moment.
These demons are still very strong in comparison, but the battle consumes a lot of money, otherwise Nie Yuan may not be able to win against one of them alone.
Eight demons were killed, and the two people who were rescued finally breathed a sigh of relief, feeling like they had walked away from the edge of hell.
"I wonder what you call senior brother and senior sister?"
Nie Yuan smiled and wiped the blood on his sword: "My name is Nie Yuan, they are..."
"Senior Brother, look, this dirty handyman disciple has splattered my blood all over me."
Nie Yuan's voice was interrupted by the woman's yelling.
The man lying on the ground gasped and shook his head slightly: "Junior Sister, do you still have the Blood Pill?"
"Yes, Senior Brother Ouyang!"
The woman hurriedly took out a crystal bottle and poured out a round, blood-red pill.
